title: billing-cluster-2 down — payment processor OOM crash
description: The payment processor microservice is crashing with OutOfMemory errors. Root cause confirmed as billing-cluster-2 being overwhelmed and exhausting heap memory. All payment submissions routed to this cluster are failing. Incident started at 11:45 UTC. Distinct issue from the billing dashboard freeze reported separately.

title: Charge API returning 500 — billing-cluster-2 root cause
description: The /api/billing/charge endpoint has been returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Error since 11:47 UTC. Investigation by the billing team shows billing-cluster-2 is in a failed state. Subscription renewals and one-time charges are all failing. Customer-facing impact is significant.

title: Settlement worker crash — billing-cluster-2 cascading failure
description: Settlement worker pods are crashing in a cascade triggered by billing-cluster-2 going down. The workers cannot write settlement records because the cluster is unreachable. End-of-day financial settlement is at risk. This is the third separate team reporting the same billing-cluster-2 root cause.

title: Routine billing report request — monthly summary for April
description: Please generate the routine monthly billing summary report for April. We need the total transaction counts, revenue breakdown by product line, and refund rates. This is a standard monthly request from the Finance leadership team. No urgency — end of month deadline.

title: Access request — billing system for new finance team member
description: Please provision read-only access to the billing management console for our new Finance Analyst joining next Monday. Access needed: billing reports dashboard, invoice viewer, and transaction search. No write permissions required. Manager approval included in attachment.
